fr_html: Le PRESIDENT fait observer que Mr. Root a exprimé le désir que l'on discutât sa proposition. Le Président insiste pour qu'on l'examine, de même qu'on examinera, à la prochaine séance, le texte de Lord Phillimore.
en_html: The PRESIDENT remarked that Mr. Root had expressed the wish that the former's proposal should be discussed. The President insisted that it should be criticised, just as Lord Phillimore's text should be criticised at the next meeting.
